title: Cattaneo–Mindlin partial slip: a cylinder pressed on a flat, then sheared (implicit mortar contact with friction, plane strain)
source: C. Cattaneo, Sul contatto di due corpi elastici: distribuzione locale degli sforzi, Rend. Accad. Naz. Lincei 27:342–348, 434–436, 474–478, 1938; R. D. Mindlin, Compliance of elastic bodies in contact, J. Appl. Mech. 16:259–268, 1949; K. L. Johnson, Contact Mechanics, Cambridge University Press 1985, §7.2 (two-dimensional contact of cylinders under a tangential force below μP): stick zone |x| < c = a √(1 − Q/(μP)), q(x) = μp₀ √(1 − x²/a²) − μp₀ (c/a) √(1 − x²/c²) inside it and μp(x) in the slip zones c ≤ |x| ≤ a

quantities.quantity: the share of the closed secondary nodes that slip, 1 − c/a (Q = 0.5 μP)
quantities.reason: the stick zone |x| < c = a √(1 − Q/(μP)) = 0.7071 a (Johnson 1985, §7.2); the contact closes over 39 nodes h = a/20 apart, so one node more or less at an edge of the stick zone moves the share by 0.026

quantities.quantity: the shear over the pressure at the centre of contact, q(0)/p(0) (Q = 0.5 μP)
quantities.reason: q = μp₀ (√(1 − x²/a²) − (c/a) √(1 − x²/c²)) in the stick zone, so q(0)/p(0) = μ(1 − c/a) at the secondary node at x = 0 (node 31); the bodies are a few half-widths deep, not half-planes, which shifts the stick zone towards the leading edge and puts the centre 2–3% above the closed form on every mesh (README)

quantities.quantity: the share of the closed secondary nodes that slip, 1 − c/a (Q = 0.75 μP)
quantities.reason: the stick zone |x| < c = a √(1 − Q/(μP)) = 0.5000 a (Johnson 1985, §7.2); the contact closes over 39 nodes h = a/20 apart, so one node more or less at an edge of the stick zone moves the share by 0.026

quantities.quantity: the shear over the pressure at the centre of contact, q(0)/p(0) (Q = 0.75 μP)
quantities.reason: q = μp₀ (√(1 − x²/a²) − (c/a) √(1 − x²/c²)) in the stick zone, so q(0)/p(0) = μ(1 − c/a) at the secondary node at x = 0 (node 31); the bodies are a few half-widths deep, not half-planes, which shifts the stick zone towards the leading edge and puts the centre 2–3% above the closed form on every mesh (README)

quantities.quantity: the largest contact pressure p₀ under the shear (Q = 0.75 μP)
quantities.reason: two bodies of one material: the shear does not change the pressure, which stays Hertz's p₀ = 2P/(πa) (Johnson 1985, §7.2); as in nl-hertz-cylinder-plane-strain
